$comment: Pinned state of the external contracts Webby implements against (design spec section 21). Reviewed and updated via `mix webby.contracts.check --update`; never hand-edit the observed fields.

webmcp-spec.why: Normative WebMCP spec. Defines `Document.modelContext`, `getTools(options)`, and the `RegisteredTool` / `ToolAnnotations` dictionaries that the extension probe reads. There are no upstream releases or tags, so the spec source is tracked by content.

webmcp-implementation-status.why: Per-browser rollout status. Webby feature-detects rather than emulating, so a browser moving from origin trial to stable (or changing its API shape) changes what Webby can actually reach.

webmcp-declarative-explainer.why: Proposed declarative authoring surface. Not implemented by Webby today; tracked so that a page-authoring path landing upstream is noticed rather than missed.

webmcp-types.why: Published TypeScript definitions for the WebMCP surface. The cheapest signal that the tool descriptor shape changed, and a candidate to type-check the extension probe against.

mcp-spec.why: MCP protocol revisions, released as date tags. Webby advertises a supported set in `Webby.MCP.Protocol`; a new tag upstream means a revision Webby has not yet considered.
